top_signals.title: Moderna CEO Sees Cancer Vaccines Working Beyond Melanoma
top_signals.summary: Moderna CEO Stephane Bancel believes the personalized mRNA cancer vaccine being developed with Merck will work in a variety of tumors. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Bancel also says the recent data leak for the cancer vaccine candidate did not come from either Moderna or Merck. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Lessons for Pentagon Procurement from the Special Operations Enterprise
top_signals.summary:
As the Pentagon races to buy hundreds of thousands of unmanned systems, acquisition professionals have turned to the special operations community to learn about how to buy commercial technologies fast. Cara Teeter, deputy assistant secretary of war for special operations analysis, resources, and capabilities, and chief technology officer for the Special Operations Forces enterprise, and Bonnie Evangelista, who leads acquisition transformation for the direct reporting portfolio manager for unmanned systems, stop by the studio. They share lessons from the competitions and marketplaces they implemented, including this summer’s inaugural accelerator event. They also discuss Project Agincourt and the new Autonomous Warfare

The post Lessons for Pentagon Procurement from the Special Operations Enterprise appeared first on War on the Rocks.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
